from copy import deepcopy


def sanitize_session_descriptor(profile):
    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
        raise TypeError("profile must be a dictionary")
    preferences = profile.get("preferences")
    if not isinstance(preferences, dict):
        raise TypeError("preferences must be a dictionary")
    if any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in preferences):
        raise TypeError("preference keys must be strings")

    result = dict(profile)
    result["preferences"].pop("debug", None)
    result["preferences"]["automation"] = False
    return result

import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict

from solution import sanitize_session_descriptor


class SanitizeSessionDescriptorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_removes_debug_sets_automation_and_preserves_order(self):
        profile = {
            "name": "session",
            "preferences": OrderedDict([
                ("theme", "dark"),
                ("debug", {"verbose": True}),
                ("automation", "previous"),
                ("locale", "en"),
            ]),
            "tail": 3,
        }
        result = sanitize_session_descriptor(profile)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["name", "preferences", "tail"])
        self.assertEqual(list(result["preferences"]), ["theme", "automation", "locale"])
        self.assertEqual(result["preferences"], {"theme": "dark", "automation": False, "locale": "en"})
        self.assertIn("debug", profile["preferences"])
        self.assertEqual(profile["preferences"]["automation"], "previous")

    def test_adds_automation_to_empty_preferences(self):
        profile = {"preferences": {}}
        self.assertEqual(sanitize_session_descriptor(profile), {"preferences": {"automation": False}})
        self.assertEqual(profile, {"preferences": {}})

    def test_deep_isolation_in_both_directions(self):
        profile = {
            "preferences": {"nested": [{"value": 1}]},
            "outside": {"items": [1, 2]},
        }
        result = sanitize_session_descriptor(profile)
        profile["preferences"]["nested"][0]["value"] = 9
        profile["outside"]["items"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result["preferences"]["nested"], [{"value": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(result["outside"], {"items": [1, 2]})

        result["preferences"]["nested"].append({"value": 2})
        result["outside"]["items"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(profile["preferences"]["nested"], [{"value": 9}])
        self.assertEqual(profile["outside"]["items"], [1, 2, 3])

    def test_malformed_profile_and_preferences(self):
        for profile in (None, [], (), "x"):
            with self.subTest(profile=profile):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    sanitize_session_descriptor(profile)
        for profile in ({}, {"preferences": None}, {"preferences": []}, {"preferences": "x"}):
            with self.subTest(profile=profile):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    sanitize_session_descriptor(profile)
        for key in (1, None, ("x",)):
            with self.subTest(key=key):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    sanitize_session_descriptor({"preferences": {key: "value"}})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
